## Summary

Implements PR 5 of the RAWAJ Spatial Marketplace roadmap.

- Immersive image-first listing detail layout
- Full-screen media viewer with swipe, keyboard, thumbnails, and zoom
- Real public seller profile data with verification, ratings, listings, and join date
- Sticky contact dock for message, offer negotiation, call, WhatsApp, and owner management
- Safety guidance, reporting, and saved-search-backed price-result alerts
- Similar listings rail using public listing filters and adaptive cards
- Dedicated responsive CSS and regression contract

## Non-goals

- No database migrations
- No new offer table or fake transaction workflow
- No changes to conversation authorization, reservation status, or moderation rules
